## Retort

### What are the generated files?

Files with the `GENERATED by Retort` header are produced by the sync
process and should not be edited directly. Customise them via overlays at
`.agentkit/overlays/retort`.

### How do I regenerate the documentation?

```bash
pnpm --dir .agentkit retort:sync
```

### Can I add custom documentation?

Yes. Add files without the `GENERATED` header in any documentation directory.
These will not be overwritten by the sync process.
